description: Questions over the raw Palmer Penguins table with hand-written reference SQL. A question passes when the generated query returns the same rows as the reference.

cases.question: How many penguins are there?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dataset

cases.question: What is the average body mass?
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(body_mass_g) FROM dataset

cases.question: What is the average body mass by species?
cases.sql: SELECT species, AVG(body_mass_g) FROM dataset GROUP BY species

cases.question: How many penguins are there per island?
cases.sql: SELECT island, COUNT(*) FROM dataset GROUP BY island

cases.question: What is the highest body mass recorded?
cases.sql: SELECT MAX(body_mass_g) FROM dataset

cases.question: What is the shortest flipper length?
cases.sql: SELECT MIN(flipper_length_mm) FROM dataset

cases.question: What is the total body mass by island?
cases.sql: SELECT island, SUM(body_mass_g) FROM dataset GROUP BY island

cases.question: What is the average bill length for each sex?
cases.sql: SELECT sex, AVG(bill_length_mm) FROM dataset WHERE sex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sex

cases.question: How many female penguins are there?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dataset WHERE sex = 'female'

cases.question: Which species has the longest average flipper length?
cases.sql: SELECT species FROM dataset GROUP BY species ORDER BY AVG(flipper_length_mm) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many Gentoo penguins live on Biscoe island?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dataset WHERE species = 'Gentoo' AND island = 'Biscoe'

cases.question: What is the average body mass of male Adelie penguins?
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(body_mass_g) FROM dataset WHERE species = 'Adelie' AND sex = 'male'

cases.question: How many penguins were observed each year?
cases.sql: SELECT year, COUNT(*) FROM dataset GROUP BY year

cases.question: How many penguins have no recorded sex?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dataset WHERE sex IS NULL

cases.question: What are the body masses of the 5 heaviest penguins?
cases.sql: SELECT body_mass_g FROM dataset ORDER BY body_mass_g DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: What is the average bill depth of penguins heavier than 5000 grams?
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(bill_depth_mm) FROM dataset WHERE body_mass_g > 5000

cases.question: How many distinct islands are there?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT island) FROM dataset

cases.question: Which island has the most penguins?
cases.sql: SELECT island FROM dataset GROUP BY island ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the maximum bill length per species?
cases.sql: SELECT species, MAX(bill_length_mm) FROM dataset GROUP BY species

cases.question: What is the average flipper length of penguins on Dream island?
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) FROM dataset WHERE island = 'Dream'
